subject: Gray tabby cat facing camera, crouched low on a wooden floor
set: Wooden table or floor with a Coca-Cola can, snacks and a blue-white fur backdrop
notes: Cat centred in the upper third, large empty floor in the foreground, subtitle placed over the floor. Camera is at floor level, so the cat looks like it is hiding.

subject: Cracked or glitching TV on the wall above a black table with a console and cup
set: Purple textured living room with a wooden floor
notes: TV is the focal point, off-centre. The table cuts diagonally across the frame. A grey object sits at the left edge. Slightly angled view of the wall.

subject: Orange tabby cat standing on its hind legs, paws on a person's knee, looking up
set: Bedroom with a blue fuzzy bed and wooden floor
notes: Human arm and jeans are cropped at the left edge. The cat is in the centre, framed by the bed at the top right and the wooden floor below.

subject: Man in a white polo and jeans sitting on a bed, petting a tabby cat
set: Bedroom with a purple wall, painting, guitar and blue bedspread
notes: Man is centred and cropped at the head and the shins. The cat is on the left and the guitar is behind him. Vertical framing.

subject: Gray tabby cat looking up at the camera
set: Patterned rug or floor with a banana at the left edge
notes: Cat's face is centred and fills the frame. Its eyes look up into the lens, the background is tilted and blurred, and the banana is partly cropped at the left.

subject: Gray tabby cat running toward the camera
set: Grassy field at night with a starry sky
notes: Cat is centred with a large empty ground area below. A red 'Zaw Poly Shorts' title sits at the top. The low camera tracks the cat, and the tail and background objects are blurred.

subject: Cat sitting in a window seen from outside
set: Orange brick wall with a grey-framed window, grey pavement
notes: Window is centred in the upper half and the cat sits small inside it. The brick wall frames the window and the pavement fills the foreground. Symmetrical vertical composition.

subject: Green bowl of cat kibble
notes: Bowl is centred. The view looks steeply down at the wooden surface, which has a drawer handle in the lower area.

subject: Man walking away from the camera, an orange cat in the left foreground, green bowl at the bottom
set: Purple bedroom/hallway with a wooden door, bookshelf and TV
notes: Camera is at floor level, behind the cat and bowl. Man is centred in the background. The foreground bowl and the cat, cropped at the left, add depth, and the floor fills the lower third.
